description: Get full details for places the user already means — by id (from discover_venues) or by name, with an optional website and town to tell same-named places apart. Pass `stay` to get live rooms and offers whose offer ids go straight to book_venue. A name that fits several places returns candidates: ask the user which, never guess. Structured JSON, not a rendered UI.

places.description: The places to match: ids, or a name with optional website and location.

id.description: A place id from discover or a previous match.

location.description: Town or area, to tell apart places with the same name.

name.description: The place name as the caller knows it.

website.description: The place's own website, if known; the strongest identity signal.

projection.description: `detail` (default) is the full record; `listing` is the compact card a list page needs.

render.description: Ask for layout hints alongside the results. Delivery (one body or a stream) is chosen by the Accept header, not here.

a2ui.description: Also return `ui`: an A2UI surface for the same results. A hint; the results are complete without it.

catalogs.description: A2UI catalog ids the caller can render.

stay.description: When given, each matched place carries its live rooms and offers for these dates and party.

name: match_venues
